objective: Make mise, which the repository ships as a dev dependency, run the gates in this container so that mise run verify passes in the worktree /home/user/holyagent-hook-locks.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-hook-locks (branch release/0.2.0/fix/hook-locks-followups-like, cut from origin/main). It has no node_modules yet. The main checkout /home/user/holyagent has node_modules with node_modules/.bin/mise (version 2026.10.24) working.

mise.toml installs bun 1.4.4 and node lts; its postinstall hook runs 'bun scripts/toolchain.ts upgrade' to move that Bun to canary, because the gates need the canary-only bun check, bun lint and bun fmt. The 'toolchain' task fails on a non-canary Bun. The container's own bun is 1.4.4 stable.

Steps to try: bun install --frozen-lockfile in the worktree; node_modules/.bin/mise trust (the config may need trusting); node_modules/.bin/mise install; then node_modules/.bin/mise run verify, and also 'bun run verify' (bun puts node_modules/.bin on PATH for scripts). Outbound HTTPS goes through a proxy (see /root/.ccr/README.md) if a download fails. Find the shortest command sequence that works from a fresh session and whether mise needs anything on PATH or in the environment.
constraints: Change no tracked file in the repository and make no version-control writes; nothing under .git/ or .holyagent/. Installing into node_modules, the mise data directories and the user's home is fine.
If a step fails, diagnose it (read the error, the proxy README) and try the reasonable fix before reporting; name anything that needs the user (for example an environment setting).
Keep working until mise run verify runs, then stop and report. Do not fix failing tests; report them with counts.

Report in under 300 words: the exact working command sequence, verify exit code and counts per gate, and anything a future session must do. Put long logs in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/b1af37dd-2976-516b-9354-81a5e7eae819/scratchpad/mise-verify.log.

criteria.text: mise run verify runs through the dev-dependency mise in the worktree, with its exit code and per-gate counts reported
The report gives the shortest command sequence that makes the gates work from a fresh session
